title: convolvulus pennatus
intro: Convolvulus pennatus, commonly known as the 'Dwarf Morning Glory', is a type of flowering plant native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Convolvulus pennatus include its use as a natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia, attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
